title: Meeting Bob Lazar and George Knapp at the start of the project

tellings.quote: I happened to meet Bob Lazar for the first time when we started this whole project >> and George Knapp and together.

plain: An author known as a CIA historian, Peter Levenda, says he met Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada base, for the first time when their project began, around 2017 to 2019, together with the Las Vegas TV journalist George Knapp. Levenda tells it as something he was there for, marking the start of his work with both men.
